# American Cleanroom Systems

> > Modular cleanroom design, manufacturing, and installation specialist serving aerospace, pharmaceutical, and laser industries with ISO 5-8 certified environments.

American Cleanroom Systems (ACR) provides turnkey modular cleanroom solutions featuring HEPA filtration, softwall and hardwall designs, and complete cleanroom equipment. The company specializes in rapid deployment (4-week builds) of ISO-classified controlled environments with expertise in particle testing, contamination control, and regulatory compliance.

## Key Topics

- Modular Cleanrooms
- ISO 5-8 Classifications
- HEPA Filtration Systems
- Softwall Cleanrooms
- Cleanroom Design & Installation
- Aerospace Cleanrooms
- Pharmaceutical Cleanrooms
- Class 100/1,000/10,000/100,000
- Contamination Control
- Airlock Systems
- Pass-Through Chambers
- Static Dissipative Flooring
- Material Transfer Systems
- Cleanroom Assembly
- ISO-14644 Standards

- [Aerospace Modular Cleanroom | 100,000/ISO8 548 S.F.](https://www.americancleanrooms.com/cleanroom/548-s-f-class-100k-iso8-modular-cleanroom): 548 sq ft ISO8/Class 100K aerospace modular cleanroom with static flooring
- [Laser Cleanrooms](https://www.americancleanrooms.com/laser-cleanrooms): Laser cleanroom design with blackout curtains, UV lighting, and interlocks
- [Softwall Cleanrooms](https://www.americancleanrooms.com/es/cuartos-limpio-de-softwall): ISO-6 to ISO-8 softwall cleanrooms with vinyl curtains and HEPA filtration
